prompt: Check that spot3 has at least 60 percent charge, then send it to stop_c.

expect_2_4.because: 0048 S4 (spot3 has no charge fact: unknown, a reading fails closed, and the request names no fallback)

why: Infeasible in 2.4: the world gives spot3 no charge, so every reading of it is unknown and fails closed (0048 S2, S4), and the request names no fallback. A program is a gamble that the check passes. Under 2.3 the attempt fails earlier, at the kind (`E217`).
